question: By what manner of conduct do devotees of the left-hand path proceed?
premises: They are devoted to the left-hand path and others.
Their conduct follows a course of non-hatred.
Devotion persists even within that path.
inference: Therefore even devotees of the left-hand path proceed by a course of non-hatred.
plain_english: Even those devoted to the left-hand path and so forth proceed by a course of non-hatred.
